relations.subject: Alexander Berzin
relations.evidence: His Holiness commissioned Sharpa Rinpoche and myself to translate a series of articles on Kalachakra written by Geshe Ngawang Dhargyey and Garjang Kamtrul Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Alexander Berzin
relations.evidence: Serkong Rinpoche was also my own root guru, whom I served for many years as interpreter. Seeing that there would be ever-growing interest in the West about Kalachakra, he taught me the subject extensively.

relations.subject: Alexander Berzin
relations.evidence: Serkong Rinpoche kindly arranged for me to receive private teachings on Kalachakra from Yongdzin Ling Rinpoche

relations.subject: Alexander Berzin
relations.evidence: Serkong Rinpoche had recommended I study Kalachakra astronomy and astrology with Gen Lodro Gyatso, the late Master Astrologer of the Tibetan Medical and Astrological Institute

relations.subject: Gen Lodro Gyatso
relations.evidence: Gen Lodro Gyatso, the late Master Astrologer of the Tibetan Medical and Astrological Institute
